description: NaLaGeP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.88 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.48 Å. Ge is bonded to five O atoms to form GeO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-1.96 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-29°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.60 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-27°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.62 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one GeO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-42°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.56 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ge and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ge and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one La and one P atom.
